mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a strong indicator of broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods with declining HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 1% in a month, it signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure in a high-interest-rate environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1% QoQ growth and HOUST declines > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
